'''''Jacaranda brasiliana''''' is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Bignoniaceae]]. It is native to [[Brazil]], including in the [[Amazon rainforest|Amazon]], [[Cerrado]], and [[Caatinga]] domains—typically from [[Mato Grosso]] to [[Minas Gerais]], and [[Pará]] to [[Bahia]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jacaranda (Jacaranda brasiliana) |url=https://garden.org/plants/view/153093/Jacaranda-Jacaranda-brasiliana/ |access-date=March 1, 2024 |website=Plants Database}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last1=Costa |first1=Swami |last2=Lohmann |first2=Lúcia G. |last3=Buril |first3=Maria Teresa |date=2019 |title=Flora of Pernambuco, Brazil: Tabebuia alliance and tribe Jacarandeae (Bignoniaceae) |url=http://dx.doi.org/10.1590/1676-0611-bn-2019-0737 |journal=Biota Neotropica |volume=19 |issue=4 |doi=10.1590/1676-0611-bn-2019-0737 |issn=1676-0611|doi-access=free }}</ref>

The flowers can be collected from November to February, with the fruit collected in February.<ref name=":0" />
